items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: we worked all around New Orleans with Sidney's band because we never did leave out of time with the band.

ctx.x: People, the people you'd be crazy about. Oh, yeah. I'd go with Tio on Saturday night sometimes and people crowd around. I don't care. I don't like that, huh?
Let's see. Anything else you can tell about Sidney Desby's band? Where did you work?

Well, we worked all around New Orleans with Sidney's band because we never did leave out of time with the band. We played mostly all the dances was in New Orleans at that time. It was during the war time.
